description: This file defines a module that creates and exports a configured Supabase client using environment variables. It provides a function getSupabaseClient() to initialize the client and creates a default supabase instance.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client configured with environment variables and specified options.

calls: createClient(url, key, { auth: { persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true, detectSessionInUrl: true } })
